description: Works number 11820201. On the Ploshchad Promyshlennosti at VDNKh since 1981; restored to its original CCCP-42304 scheme and reopened as an exhibition and simulator space. Open to visitors as part of the Cosmonautics and Aviation Centre.
Works number 4231, bort "70 yellow". Installed at VDNKh in April 2015. Wears bort number 70; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.

Works number 36911027311, bort "27 red". Installed at VDNKh in April 2015 and used with the centre's flight simulator programme. Wears bort number 27; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.
Full-scale mock-up, izdeliye 0.15, also catalogued as BTS-001. Moved from Gorky Park to VDNKh in summer 2014 and opened as an interactive exhibit. A mock-up, never a flight vehicle.
Full-scale mock-up of the three-stage Vostok 8K72K launch vehicle standing on Ploshchad Promyshlennosti.
Sub-scale unmanned orbital spaceplane test article from the Buran programme, displayed inside pavilion 34.
Flown descent module displayed inside pavilion 34.

Descent module displayed in pavilion 34 as the Vostok-1 capsule. The flown Vostok-1 descent module is normally shown at RKK Energia, so this exhibit is most probably a duplicate or mock-up; the museum labelling has not been checked against a primary source.
Full-scale mock-up of the Mir orbital station displayed in pavilion 34.
Multipurpose transport supply spacecraft of the Almaz programme, displayed in pavilion 34.
Mock-up of the Almaz military orbital station displayed in pavilion 34.
Mock-up of the self-propelled lunar rover displayed in pavilion 34.
